title: Systemutvecklare med fokus på moderna plattformar
description:
På Migrationsverket arbetar vi med en av vår tids stora samhällsfrågor – migrationen. Totalt är vi cirka 6 000 personer här, och vi har ett ovanligt viktigt jobb!

##### **Vi söker just nu systemutvecklare som vill arbeta i ett möjliggörande plattformsteam där fokus ligger på att bygga robusta tekniska lösningar och ge andra utvecklingsteam rätt förutsättningar att lyckas.**


Låter det intressant? Då hoppas vi att du läser vidare.


Migrationsverket genomför just nu en långsiktig förflyttning från en högt integrerad arkitektur till en mer löst kopplad och skalbar arkitektur.


Ditt uppdrag blir att vara en del av ett team som, tillsammans med övriga utvecklingsteam, driver denna transformation framåt – mot ett mer flexibelt, modernt och effektivt sätt att utveckla system och tjänster.


Som kollega på Migrationsverket får du arbeta i en tekniskt utmanande miljö där vi kontinuerligt förbättrar våra lösningar och arbetssätt. Här kombineras samhällsnytta med modern systemutveckling – du bidrar till lösningar som gör verklig skillnad, samtidigt som du har en trygg och stabil anställning.

##### **Vad gör en systemutvecklare på Migrationsverket?**


Som systemutvecklare hos oss blir du en del av ett plattformsteam som arbetar tätt tillsammans med andra utvecklingsteam. Vi jobbar med hög grad av autonomi i teamen, moderna tekniker och ett kontinuerligt fokus på att leverera värde.


Vi lägger stor vikt vid en stark teamkultur – vi delar kunskap, lär av varandra och värdesätter olika perspektiv.


Vi arbetar agilt med stort fokus på automatisering och rör oss mot en löst kopplad, eventbaserad arkitektur. Just nu bygger vi också upp en modern, cloud native-plattform baserad på Kubernetes och Docker.


Du kommer att, tillsammans med dina nya kollegor:

* utveckla verktyg, tekniker och ramverk som förenklar och effektiviserar utvecklingsarbetet – både för er själva och andra team
* skapa tekniska förutsättningar för stabila och kontinuerliga leveranser
* arbeta med test som en naturlig del av utvecklingsprocessen
* samarbeta nära teamens användare, förvaltning samt drift- och supportorganisation


Vi har ett starkt fokus på ständiga förbättringar – både i hur vi arbetar och i det vi bygger. Här finns goda möjligheter att påverka tekniska val, arbetssätt och riktning.


Du blir en del av en organisation där tekniska utmaningar möter samhällsviktiga behov – och där din kompetens gör konkret skillnad.


Läs mer om att jobba med IT hos oss: Jobba med it

##### **Vem är du?**


Du trivs i team där samarbete är centralt och där man gemensamt tar ansvar för leveransen. Du är trygg i din kompetens, har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och ett starkt kvalitetstänk – både i din egen kod och i teamets leverans.


Du har förmåga att se helheten, förstå olika behov och bidra till lösningar som fungerar i ett större sammanhang.

##### **Du som söker har**

* högskole- eller universitetsstudier inom datavetenskap, programvaruteknik eller datateknik med kandidat- eller masterexamen, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet
* minst 2 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling
* god kommunikativ förmåga och kan uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska


Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet, särskilt din samarbetsförmåga, ansvarstagande och ditt omdöme i komplexa tekniska miljöer.

##### **Det är meriterande om du har**

* erfarenhet av att arbeta med löst kopplade arkitekturer
* erfarenhet av event streaming, exempelvis Kafka
* erfarenhet av mikrotjänster och mikrotjänstarkitektur
* kunskap inom utveckling av plattformsprodukter och utvecklingsverktyg
* erfarenhet av containerplattformar (Kubernetes/Docker)
* erfarenhet av DevOps och agila arbetssätt
* erfarenhet av CI/CD

##### **Upplysningar**


Anställningsform: Tillsvidare  

Arbetstider: Kontorstider  

Placering: Linköping  

Möjlighet till distansarbete: Ja, delvis utifrån verksamhetens behov  

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse  

Förmåner & villkor: Läs om våra anställningsförmåner här.  

Sista ansökningsdatum: Vi gör urval löpande men vill ha din ansökan senast den 6 September 2026

##### **Vill du veta mer**


Vill du veta mer om rollen och enheten finns kontaktuppgifter till ansvarig enhetschef längre ned.


\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ Om rekryteringsprocessen För oss är det viktigt att all kompetens på arbetsmarknaden tillvaratas. Vi välkomnar därför alla sökande och strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och mångfald. Som statlig myndighet rekryterar vi efter förtjänst och skicklighet. På arbetsgivarverket.se kan du läsa mer om vad det innebär. Du behöver inte bifoga något personligt brev med din ansökan, men vi önskar att du svarar så tydlig ochutförligt som möjligt på urvalsfrågorna för att vi ska kunna göra en rättvis bedömning av din erfarenhet om du är kvalificerad att gå vidare i rekryteringen eller inte. I vissa rekryteringar använder vi också tester för att bedöma hur väl din skicklighet stämmer överens med tjänsten du söker. Vid en eventuell intervju kan du även få svara på frågor kopplat till säkerhet. title: Android Developer
description:
**Are you passionate about creating a great gaming experience and developing a scalable product? Come help us build the best geography game! You will be a part of a team with huge impact, shaping the experience for our amazing 100 million players.**  

  

At GeoGuessr, we’ve been doing more than just making a game - we’ve created an experience that turns the world into a playground for the curious and knowledge-hungry, letting everyone explore in a fun and engaging way. During the last couple of years we have focused on building an incredible team, now just over 80 people, and craft new ways for our dedicated players to experience our fantastic geography games. GeoGuessr is widely played all around the world and have a large and dedicated community.

**The role**

  

We’re looking for an Android Developer to join our tech team. As part of a collaborative group of developers, you’ll be responsible for writing clean, high-quality code and working on new features and experiments to support the growth and development of our platform.  

  



Together, we develop a fantastic gaming experience in a fast-moving environment where you and your team have overall responsibility for the delivery.


You understand the value of delivering weekly improvements and new features to our millions of players. With your technical skills and player-first mindset, you’ll strike the perfect balance between crafting features people love and maintaining a top-tier product.  

  

Why not check out the app yourself?!

 **What we hope you’ll bring:**

* Experience building high fidelity custom Kotlin components
* Implementing custom animations
* Comfort and familiarity with REST and Websockets
* A university degree in computer science or equivalent experience

**It's a bonus if you have experience in:**

* Design and UX
* Motions, sounds and haptics
* Game development (on any platform)

**Wait, there's more!**


We're offering a package of perks to keep you charged up and ready to create wonders:

* Daily breakfast and lunch at the office.
* 6 weeks of vacation + 3 extra days off, for a well-deserved rest.
* Pension and insurance as per ITP1 guidelines.
* 50,000 SEK education benefit.
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance.
* A high energy and very much alive office.


We encourage exercise during working hours. We provide a large selection of snacks and drinks for recovery. A home to simply enjoy.

  

This role is based in Stockholm where we have invested in creating our unique home at Katarinavägen 17, in the glass house by Slussen.

title: Fullstack Developer - AI-Enhanced Development - Bulgaria
description:
Join Mitigram as a Fullstack Developer and help build our next-generation trade platform and AI-assisted products. We're looking for engineers who can hit the ground running in a modern, clean architecture and are eager to embrace AI as an integral part of the development workflow.
   

  

 If you're excited about the future of development—where AI amplifies your capabilities rather than replaces them — this role is for you.
   

  

**About Mitigram**
 Mitigram is the leading digital platform for global trade financing. It is on a journey to build the largest and most comprehensive trade finance network, leveraging data to enable insights and accelerate the digitalisation of global trade and trade finance.
   

  

 As a growing company with a collaborative, innovative team, we offer an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on cutting-edge projects. Join us as we shape the future of Trade Finance!
   

  

****Why You’ll Love This Role****
 We don’t just allow AI tools -we integrate them.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate with
 **AI-powered development agents** 
 like Claude Code that understand our architecture and workflows, enabling you to build faster, cleaner, and smarter.
   

  

****Our Tech Stack****
**Backend**
* .NET 8 with C# 13 (using the latest language features)
* Domain-Driven Design (DDD): aggregate roots, entities, value objects
* CQRS pattern via Mediator
* SQL Server + Dapper (high-performance data access)
* Redis for distributed caching
* xUnit and Test Driven Development


**Frontend**
* Svelte 4, Typescript, Angular
* SASS/CSS and design system integration
* Vite for modern build tooling with HMR
* Testing with Vitest
* Collaboration through Figma


**Infrastructure**
* Azure cloud-native deployment
* Docker + Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration
* JWT/OAuth/SAML for enterprise authentication


****What You’ll Bring to Succeed****
**Must Have:**
* Comfort using AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude, etc.)
* Strong C#/.NET background with solid DDD understanding
* Experience with CQRS or similar architectural patterns
* Proficiency in a modern reactive framework - Angular + Typescript (or Svelte experience)
* Strong TypeScript and type-safe coding practices
* SQL expertise—you write queries, not just use ORMs
* TDD mindset—tests are part of how you think
* 5-7 years of professional experience in full-stack development
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated experience in full-stack software development.


**Nice to Have:**
* Svelte experience (or eagerness to learn fast)
* Dapper or micro-ORM familiarity
* Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services


****The Mindset We’re Looking For****
 🤖
 **AI-First Thinking** 
 – You treat AI as a collaborator that accelerates your output and quality.
   

  

 🏗️
 **Architecture Matters** 
 – You care deeply about clean code and maintainable systems.
   

  

 🧪
 **Test-Driven** 
 – You write tests to move faster and deploy confidently.
   

  

 🎨
 **Craft & Quality** 
 – You take pride in both backend elegance and frontend polish.
   

  

 🚀
 **Ownership** 
 – You ship features end-to-end, from database to UI.
   

  

****What You’ll Build****
* Secure enterprise authentication (SSO, MFA, social login)
* User and organisation management features
* Security-critical, auditable systems
* Responsive, accessible frontends
* API integrations across Mitigram’s ecosystem
* Scalable microservices


****Our Development Culture****
* API-First Development – clear contracts and strong types
* Code Review & Collaboration – we learn and grow together
* AI Integration – specialised agents that understand our patterns
* Continuous Deployment – ship fast, ship often


**About The Team**
 You’ll join a team that values technical excellence, clean architecture, and pragmatic engineering. Together, we’re building critical infrastructure for Mitigram’s global trade platform—work that matters, done right.
   

  

****As a Mitizen****
* You will be part of cutting-edge projects in Trade Finance.
* Have the opportunity to collaborate with a curious, open, and innovative team.
* You will enjoy career growth opportunities and professional development support.
* You will benefit from a learning budget, comprehensive health insurance, and a strong focus on work-life balance.
* You will make a tangible impact in a growing, fast-paced company.


****What happens next?****
 If you believe this position aligns with your skills and career goals, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We will review applications on a rolling basis.
   

  

 At Mitigram, we’re open and curious, so if you are not entirely confident you meet our exact criteria, apply anyway —we value many other qualities as well. We're committed to building an inclusive and diverse team. We welcome applications from developers of all backgrounds who share our passion for technical excellence and innovation.
   

  

****Reference and Background Checks****
 As part of the recruitment process, we will ask the final candidate for references and conduct a background check.

title: iOS Developer
description:
**Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!** 




  





 Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:
 



  




* We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
* We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
* We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities



  





 We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.
 



  





**The role:** 




**As a Software Engineer, iOS,** 
 you will have an impact on how our users use the iOS app. You will be working on the whole app from authentication to the search feature, and you will also work very closely with all the other teams in the company to achieve our company vision: enabling each person or business to maintain a secure and trusted online identity.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Design, develop, and maintain the company's iOS application
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
* Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of the app
* Debug complex technical issues and identify solutions to improve the app
* Stay up-to-date with new technologies and trends in iOS development
* Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code
* Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards
* Contribute to the technical design and architecture of the app
* Participate in the full software development life cycle, including planning, development, testing, and deployment.



  





**What you bring in** 



* 3-5 years of overall experience with iOS development
* Advanced knowledge of programming using Swift
* Deep understanding and several years of hands-on experience in Cocoa and iOS application development (architectures, design, tools, SDKs), asynchronous server communication, and UX optimization
* Experience in agile development
* Fluent communication skills in oral and written English



  





**It would be great if you also have** 



* SwiftUI experience
* Swift async/await experience
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions and Fastlane



  





**What we offer:** 




 We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:
 








* A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
* Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
* A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
* **Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination:** 
 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.



  





**Come as you are:** 




 Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.
 



  





**Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code:** 
 https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/
 



 Sounds like a great opportunity?
 



  





 We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.
 



  





**We only accept applications in English.**

title: Software Engineer - Backend
description:
**Who We Are**
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
   

  

 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
   

  

 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
   

  

**The role**
 At Helsing we develop and deliver AI-based capabilities and the enabling infrastructure that allow semi-autonomous platforms to localise, navigate, and perceive the world in real time. We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations, so
 **must** 
 be both reliable and frictionless. Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that you’ll help us solve. To give some examples:
   

  

* Distributed systems (e.g., intermittent connectivity and byzantine actors)
* Embedded computing (e.g., resource-constrained compute and reverse-engineering)
* Robotics (e.g., control systems and tasking)
* Networking (e.g., long-range low-bandwidth radios and cross-medium routing)
* Deployment infrastructure (e.g., air-gapped devices and heterogenous fleets)
* Security (e.g., data sharing in low-trust, no-TLS networks and actually-secret data handling)
* Machine learning (e.g., systems for model development, storage, and dissemination)


 In several of these areas, we are working near the state-of-the-art; we actively read (and sometimes implement) research papers, and often need to push even further to make theory work in practice. In others, we are applying well-known techniques to real-world situations (with real-world limitations) that have never been used in before, which requires skill, diligence, and honing a deep understanding of the underlying technologies.
   

  

**The day-to-day**
* Review code contributions, proposals, and RFCs from colleagues. At Helsing we strongly believe that unblocking others takes precedence over spending more time on your own work.
* Propose and implement new features, capabilities, algorithms, infrastructure, or even full products across our stack. We encourage our engineers to look beyond their immediate team for missed opportunities, and to speak up when they identify one.
* Become a mentor, find a mentee, and help support and develop our interviewing pipeline. The people make or break the company, and we want as many engineers as possible to be part of fostering and growing the organisation.
* Share your experience and technical know-how with other Helsingers. We host tech talks, get together for smaller “let’s learn together” groups, run topical office hours (e.g., on Rust), etc. to help each other get better with time.
* Maintain our existing software stack, including working with internal and external customers to identify issues, improving operational reliability and performance, and fending off technical debt. The stack is a mix of Rust and Python, with Python mainly living in the ML-heavy sections.
* Further develop our tests and benchmarks, both at the micro and macro level. We operate in a domain where robustness is of the utmost importance, and an extensive and ever-improving test suite is key to achieving that. And without thorough benchmarks, we would be flying blind.
* Present your work at our weekly demo sessions. We want engineers to come together around what they are working on and to feel like they are not endlessly squirrelling away at something that doesn’t matter. To that end, we host (and actively work towards) demo sessions that allow early feedback, celebration of progress, and a better shared understanding of everything that goes on at Helsing.


**You should apply if you**
* Can write legible, maintainable, and performant code.
* Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing.
* Enjoy collaborating with others, including reviewing code and pair programming.
* Are comfortable working asynchronously (writing PRs and RFCs, having discussions by email).
* Have backend development experience, ideally with a language like Rust, Java, Go, or C++.
* Are familiar with backend interface tools like REST, GraphQL, gRPC/Protocol Buffers, and Arrow.
* Strive to improve yourself, your peers, and the culture you work in over time.
* Feel like ethical considerations are an inherent part of engineering.


*Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically* 
*under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.*
**Nice to have**
* Rust and Python specifically.
* Container-based and cloud-native application architectures (e.g., Docker, Azure, AWS).
* Metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
* SQL and streaming database systems.
* Routing protocols (e.g., IGP, BGP).
* Cryptographic protocols (e.g., Signal, WireGuard).
* Hardware interfaces (e.g., Arduino).
* Robotics (e.g., control systems).
* Production ML systems.


**Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields**
* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.


**What We Offer**
* A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking
* Competitive compensation and VSOP options
* Relocation support
* Social and education allowances
* Regular company events and all-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe
* A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one


*Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.*
 Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

title: Fullstack Engineer - Billing Platform
description:
**Introducing evroc**
 At evroc, we are building a secure, sovereign, and sustainable hyperscale cloud to reimagine the digital future of Europe. By joining our company, you have an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation cloud services. We are seeking intellectually curious and highly motivated team members who are ready to embrace the thrilling challenge of building the first European owned hyperscale cloud.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Stockholm
   

  

**Job type:** 
 Permanent position
   

  

**Join the Pioneers**
 We’re looking for a Software Engineer to build evroc’s next-generation Billing Platform, a system that processes millions of events and powers usage-based pricing, invoicing, and revenue flows across our cloud.
   

  

 In this role, you will work across the full stack, connecting event-driven backend systems with intuitive, data-heavy user interfaces. You’ll build the tools that people rely on to understand and manage complex billing scenarios with accuracy and confidence.
   

  

 This is a high-impact role where you’ll own features end-to-end and help define how billing is experienced across evroc’s platform.
   

  

**What You’ll Tackle**
* Design and build fullstack features across the billing lifecycle, from backend services to user-facing interfaces.
* Develop billing consoles and dashboards, including usage visualisation, invoice management, and subscription workflows.
* Build tools for managing pricing models, SKUs, and discount structures used by product and commercial teams.
* Design APIs that abstract complex billing logic into clear and reliable contracts for frontend consumption.
* Implement data-heavy interfaces such as cost projections, usage trends, and reconciliation views.
* Establish frontend patterns and components for scalable, high-performance administrative interfaces.
* Work closely with product and design to translate complex billing concepts into intuitive user workflows.
* Integrate billing systems with external services such as payment providers, accounting systems, and CRMs.


**Skills We Value**
* 5+ years of experience in fullstack engineering, ideally building data-intensive web applications.
* Backend experience in Golang or Python, building APIs and handling authentication, versioning, and middleware.
* Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript
* Solid understanding of databases (SQL/NoSQL), including schema design, indexing, and performance considerations.
* Experience working with complex system integrations and external services.
* Familiarity with SaaS billing concepts such as invoicing, usage-based pricing, and subscription management.
* Ability to translate complex data and systems into clear, reliable user experiences.


**Why Join evroc?**
 We offer a competitive salary and an equity package to attract the best. Whether it’s the cosmopolitan allure of London, the vibrant Stockholm, or the Mediterranean charm of Sophia Antipolis, you’re poised for an inspiring work environment and a captivating local culture!
   

  

 At evroc, diversity is our strength. We champion an inclusive environment where every background - ethnicity, age, gender identity, beliefs, and culture - is celebrated.
   

  

 Applicants must possess a valid work permit.

title: Systemutvecklare
description:
*Vill du göra samhällsnytta och bidra till Sveriges oberoende i världen? Just nu söker vi en systemutvecklare som vill bygga den teknik som krävs för att vi ska kunna leverera unika underrättelser. På FRA är varje arbetsuppgift en del av något större. Är du den vi söker kan vi erbjuda ett varierande arbete i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där du får vara med och göra skillnad varje dag.*
 Ditt uppdrag
   

  

 Som systemutvecklare hör du till en enhet inom avdelningen för Teknik. Tillsammans bygger vi den teknik som krävs för att vi ska kunna leverera unika underrättelser till våra uppdragsgivare.
   

  

 I rollen som Systemutvecklare får du arbeta med hela kedjan och är delaktig från första idén till driftsättning. Du arbetar nära både användaren och andra funktioner på myndigheten. Hos oss blir du del av ett team som arbetar agilt enligt Scrum. Vi har ett nära samarbete inom gruppen som uppmuntrar till kreativitet och nytänkande.
   

  

 Resor i och utanför Sverige kan förekomma.
   

  

 På FRA har vi en stark sekretess och det är viktigt att du är bekväm med att hantera det.
   

  

 Du kan
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* Civilingenjörsexamen
* Kunskap eller erfarenhet inom området för radio och telekommunikation
* Erfarenhet av objektorienterad systemutveckling från studier eller arbete
* Erfarenhet av Linux från studier eller arbete
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska
* B-körkort


 Vi ser det som meriterande om du har kunskap inom ett eller flera av nedan områden:
   

  

* Java, Javascript, Rust, Go, C, C++ eller C#
* Databas exempelvis PostgreSQL eller mySQL
* GUI-ramverk exempelvis Svelte, React
* DevOpsverktyg exempelvis Git, Ansible, Jira
* Nätverk exempelvis switchar, routrar och protokoll
* Hårdvaruutveckling


 Du är
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Med Följande Egenskaper**
* Samarbetsförmåga – Arbetar bra med andra människor. Relaterar sig till dem på ett lyhört och smidigt sätt. Lyssnar, kommunicerar och löser konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.
* Initiativtagande – Tar initiativ, sätter igång aktiviteter och uppnår resultat.
* Serviceinriktad – Är lugn, uppmärksam och tillmötesgående i sitt bemötande. Har intresse, vilja och förmåga att hjälpa andra och anstränger sig för att leverera lösningar.
* Mål- och resultatorienterad – Arbetar mot mål och fokuserar på resultat. Styrs av mål-och resultattänkande i prioriteringar, planering och agerande. Förändrar sin inriktning när målen ändrar sig.


 Om FRA
   

  

 FRA har omvärlden som sin arena där varje arbetsuppgift är en del av något större. På ett eller annat sätt får du som medarbetare vara med och bidra till att skydda Sveriges integritet och oberoende i världen. Du är med och gör skillnad på riktigt, varje dag.
   

  

 Vår uppgift som underrättelsetjänst är att skydda Sverige mot de allvarligaste hot som kan riktas mot ett samhälle – militära angrepp, terrorism och cyberattacker. Vi skyddar det viktigaste vi har – vår trygghet, vår demokrati och vårt sätt att leva. Vi är experter på cyberområdet och signalspaning samt en larmklocka för militära hot.
   

  

 FRA leder sedan 2024 Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter, NCSC vars uppdrag är att utveckla och stärka Sveriges förmåga att förebygga, upptäcka och hantera cyberhot.
   

  

 Som nyanställd på FRA får du en omfattande introduktionsutbildning och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling, vilket ger dig möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter och bli ännu bättre på det du brinner för. Vår organisation är mångfacetterad och består av olika kompetenser och personligheter, där varje individ har unika egenskaper och förutsättningar. Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla känner sig välkomna och trygga. Utöver en stimulerande arbetsmiljö erbjuder vi också ett attraktivt förmånspaket, som du kan läsa mer om på www.fra.se . För mer information om Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter besök www.ncsc.se
   

  

 För din trygghet. För vår demokrati. Varje dag. Året om.
   

  

 Mer information
   

  

 Arbetsplatsen är belägen i närheten av Drottningholm, ca 10 min från Brommaplan. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav då anställning vid FRA innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Innan en anställning kommer du att säkerhetsprövas i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagens bestämmelser. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning. För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef på telefon 010-557 43 43. Fackliga företrädare nås på 010-557 46 00.
   

  

 Vi tar emot ansökningar via www.fra.se

title: Senior Lead Developer
description:
***Senior Technical Lead & Development Process Owner***




  





**Om Yump** 




 Vi har alla varit där: kön som växer och skapar frustration, väntan i provrummet eller kunden som lämnar utan att ha fått hjälp. Små ögonblick som kan avgöra om en kund blir engagerad eller lämnar, om försäljningen ökar eller intäkter går förlorade. För verksamheter inom detaljhandel och service med höga kundvolymer är det en ständig utmaning att skapa en riktigt bra upplevelse i varje kontakt.
 



  





 Det är precis det Yump är byggt för. Plattformen gör kund- och medarbetarupplevelsen mätbar och möjlig att agera på – i realtid. Med smart mjukvara, uppkopplad hårdvara och ett intuitivt gränssnitt får medarbetarna i verksamhetens frontlinje det stöd de behöver, precis när de behöver det.
 



  





 Yump har redan fått förtroendet från ledande globala varumärken och hjälper verksamheter att minska friktion, öka effektiviteten och stärka engagemanget hos medarbetarna. Nu lanseras Yump som en fristående plattform med ännu större ambitioner, att bygga nästa generations infrastruktur för arbete i frontlinjen.
 



  





 Vill du vara med och forma framtiden? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Yump söker en senior utvecklare som kombinerar djup teknisk kompetens med en stark förmåga att ta ägarskap över och driva utvecklingsplanering, leverans och processer.
 



  





 Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med Lead Architect och en Backend Developer som teknisk jämlike och bidra med högkvalitativ kod i en varierad teknisk miljö. Samtidigt ansvarar du för roadmap, planering, uppgiftshantering, uppföljning av framsteg samt för att kommunicera tidsplaner och status till produktledning och andra intressenter.
 



 Fördelningen är ungefär 70 % utveckling och 30 % planering, men planeringsdelen är en viktig del av rollen. Det här är alltså inte en projektledarroll som har lagts ovanpå en utvecklartjänst. Du är en Senior Engineer som trivs med den strukturerade och kommunikativa delen av att få mjukvara hela vägen i mål.
 



  





**Teknisk miljö** 




 Yumps plattform omfattar en bred teknisk miljö. Backend är huvudsakligen byggd i C# (.NET) och Python, med en mikrotjänstbaserad arkitektur och MongoDB som primär databas.
 



  





 Infrastrukturen är hostad i Azure och bygger på en modern DevOps-miljö med bland annat containerbaserade deploymenter och GitOps. Plattformen omfattar även AI-drivna tjänster och inbyggd C-firmware för fysiska hårdvaruenheter.
 



  





**Vad vi söker: tekniskt** 



* Du är en stark .NET/C#-utvecklare som är bekväm med att arbeta både i etablerade kodbaser och i moderna, containeriserade mikrotjänster. Erfarenhet av Python är meriterande.
* Gedigen förståelse för objektorienterad design, arkitektur och återanvändbar kod. Du har också gott omdöme när det gäller att fatta beslut om hur system bör struktureras och hur olika delar ska kommunicera med varandra.
* Lead Architect har det yttersta ansvaret för arkitektur och större tekniska beslut, men du förväntas kunna delta i dessa diskussioner som en teknisk jämlike – komma med förslag, utmana befintliga lösningar och bidra på ett meningsfullt sätt, snarare än att enbart verkställa beslut.



  





**Vad vi söker: planering och process** 



* Definiera och upprätthålla en utvecklingsprocess som fungerar för ett litet och snabbfotat team – och välja samt anpassa rätt metodik i stället för att slaviskt följa ett färdigt ramverk.
* Bryta ner projekt i tydliga och väl avgränsade uppgifter och säkerställa att teamet är samordnat kring prioriteringarna.
* Underhålla och kommunicera utvecklingsroadmaps till produktledning och andra intressenter.
* Ge realistiska uppskattningar och följa upp framsteg på ett transparent sätt.
* Samordna ett mindre, distribuerat team med olika fokusområden såsom backend, frontend, styling och firmware, inklusive en extern hårdvaruingenjör.



  





**Ett AI-drivet förhållningssätt till utveckling** 




 Yump använder AI-assisterad utveckling, framför allt med Claude, i hela organisationen och investerar stort i detta område.
 



 Det handlar inte om enkel autocomplete eller så kallad ”vibe coding”. Yump bygger komplexa system med flera tjänster genom ett specifikationsdrivet arbetssätt som bland annat omfattar återanvändbara AI-skills och specialiserade agenter, kodstandarder, linting-regler och strukturerade processer för granskning.
 



  





**Den ideala kandidaten:** 



* Har redan erfarenhet av AI-baserade utvecklingsverktyg som Claude, Cursor, Copilot eller liknande och ser den transformativa potentialen.
* Förstår att effektiv AI-assisterad utveckling av komplexa system kräver mer planering och struktur, tydliga specifikationer, väl definierade krav, design-by-contract och noggranna kodgranskningar.
* Kan formulera krav och arkitektoniska intentioner tydligt i skrift, eftersom detta har blivit en central utvecklingskompetens.
* Har den senioritet som krävs för att kritiskt utvärdera och granska AI-genererad kod, arkitektur, tester och dokumentation,och inte okritiskt acceptera det som AI:n producerar.



  





 På många sätt är de planerings- och AI-kompetenser Yump söker två sidor av samma mynt: strukturerat tänkande, tydlig kommunikation och förmågan att bryta ner komplexa problem i väldefinierade delar.
 



  





**Varför Yump?** 




 På Yump får du friheten, ansvaret och möjligheten att göra verklig skillnad. Du blir en del av ett team som gillar att utmana status quo och skapa konkret värde för våra kunder.
 



 Svenska är meriterande och engelska är ett krav.
 



  





 Kontoret ligger i vackra Gamla Stan i Stockholm, och vi erbjuder en hybrid arbetsmodell.
 



  





**Ansökan** 




 I den här rekryteringsprocessen samarbetar Yump med Salesgroup.
 



 Salesgroup tillämpar en fördomsfri och inkluderande rekryteringsprocess och arbetar i enlighet med diskrimineringslagstiftningen för att motverka diskriminering och främja lika rättigheter och möjligheter.
 



  





 Om du har frågor eller behöver teknisk support när du skickar in din ansökan är du alltid välkommen att kontakta oss på +46 (0)8 26 20 00.
 



  





 Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande, så vi rekommenderar att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

title: Fullstackutvecklare
description:
*Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens bolåneerbjudande? Vi söker en senior fullstackutvecklare med ett tydligt fokus på frontend, där du blir en nyckelperson i utvecklingen av Skandiabankens digitala kundupplevelse på webben.*
**Att jobba som fullstackutvecklare**
 Som fullstackutvecklare inom teamet Låneansökan blir du en del av ett tvärfunktionellt team som arbetar med bankens bolån.
   

  

 Med ett tydligt fokus på React får du utveckla Skandiabankens digitala kundupplevelse på webben. Rollen ger dig ett brett ansvar med möjlighet att påverka arkitektur, tekniska vägval och hur våra lösningar utvecklas över tid.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära product owner, UX och övriga utvecklare och testare. Rollen ger dig en helhetsförståelse för teamets lösningar och hur de samverkar med andra system i bankens IT-landskap.
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett team med hög teknisk kompetens där kunskapsdelning, samarbete och inflytande över arbetssätt är en självklar del av vardagen.
   

  

**Du Kommer Bland Annat Att**
* utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar inom bolåneområdet
* ta ägarskap för teamets applikationer och deras integrationer
* påverka arkitektur och tekniska vägval
* bidra till hög kodkvalitet genom kontinuerliga förbättringar och minskad teknisk skuld
* utforska och bidra till hur AI kan användas för att skapa bättre lösningar för både kunder och utvecklare


**För att lyckas i rollen**
 Du är en erfaren utvecklare som drivs av att lösa komplexa problem och omsätta affärsbehov till hållbara tekniska lösningar. Du har ett genuint intresse för frontendutveckling och motiveras av att skapa moderna, användarvänliga lösningar med hög kvalitet. Du kan dessutom kommunicera tekniska resonemang på ett tydligt sätt med både utvecklare och andra intressenter.
   

  

 Du trivs i en miljö där kunskapsdelning är en självklar del av vardagen och där du gärna coachar och stöttar andra utvecklare. Samarbete är viktigt för dig och du tror på laget före jaget.
   

  

 Som person är du självgående, kommunikativ och prestigelös, med en stark vilja att kontinuerligt förbättra både teknik och arbetssätt. Du uppskattar att arbeta i ett agilt team där dialog, nyfikenhet och samarbete är avgörande för att lyckas.
   

  

**Du Har Flerårig Erfarenhet Av**
* React och TypeScript
* C#, ASP.NET Core/.NET och Microsoft SQL Server
* REST, WCF och Azure DevOps
* Enhetstester och automatiserade tester


**Vad händer nu?**
 Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv bedömning.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Stefan Nyström på stefan.ravelius@skandia.se
   

  

 Om du har frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition Partner, Nina Fazeli på nina.fazeli@skandia.se
   

  

 Vi återkopplar till alla som söker, oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
**Mer om IT**
 Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsamamans är vårt motto!
   

  

 Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv.
   

  

 Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.
   

  

  

  

**Mer om Banken**
 Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.
   

  

 Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.
   

  

**Vårt Erbjudande Inkluderar**
* Låna: Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
* Spara: Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
* Betala: Lönekonto samt smidiga kort- och betalningstjänster.


 Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

title: Software Engineer – Automotive AI Inference Stack
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are seeking a passionate Software Engineer for Automotive AI Inference to develop and optimize the software stack that enables machine learning inference on Infineon Automotive microcontrollers.
 



 In this role, you will work at the intersection of machine learning, compiler technologies, embedded software, runtime optimization, and automotive systems. You will contribute to building the foundational software components that allow ML models to be deployed efficiently on automotive-grade MCUs while meeting stringent requirements for performance, memory utilization, reliability, and functional safety.
 



 You will collaborate closely with MCU architects, automotive application teams, and strategic customers to deliver production-ready AI software solutions for next-generation vehicles.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design and implement high-performance inference runtimes for Infineon Automotive microcontrollers and integrate AI inference pipelines into embedded software stacks and real-time operating system environments.
* Optimize models and runtime performance for latency, memory usage, power efficiency, and reliability.
* Utilize MCU-specific acceleration capabilities and architecture-specific optimizations and implement highly efficient mathematical libraries for embedded inference.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams including firmware, hardware, and algorithm engineers to ensure successful system integration.
* Support maintainable deployment processes through version control, reproducibility, and traceability.
* Evaluate and apply appropriate tools and frameworks for model conversion, quantization, and on-device inference.
* Support strategic automotive customers during proof-of-concept and production phases and provide technical guidance on AI deployment best practices.



  
 



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in: Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or a related technical field
* Expert-level C/C++ development.
* Good understanding of model quantization, memory optimization and performance tuning on constrained hardware.
* Experience deploying AI/ML models to edge devices using frameworks or toolchains such as TensorFlow Lite Micro, ONNX, ExecuTorch, or similar
* Familiarity with sensor or signal processing workflows, including time-series data such as vibration, audio, current, or power signals.
* Debugging and problem-solving skills across software, model, and hardware integration layers.
* Ability to support the full deployment lifecycle from prototype through production.
* Proactive self-starter who takes ownership, contributes to strategic discussions, adapts to evolving priorities, and helps shape the future of our products.
* Collaborative engineer who maintains high programming standards while supporting colleagues and ensuring customer success.



  
 



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience in Automotive embedded applications, incl. experience with / exposure to ISO 26262 and AUTOSAR requirements.
* Experience with MCU-based AI acceleration or related edge inference platforms.
* Knowledge of model lifecycle management, firmware release processes, and production validation.
* Experience using Python-based ML tools for model preparation, evaluation, and conversion



  
 



**What we offer:** 



* The opportunity to further develop our development platform, responsible for bringing deep learning to the edge
* Being a part of an excellent international team with highly motivated individuals striving for a common goal
* A chance to be a part of solving real-world problems using ML
* Competitive salary, wellness allowance, possibility to attend online-courses
* A humble and an open-minded company culture
* Opportunities to grow with the company and advance your career
* Short decision paths, we love getting things done
* An office in central Stockholm and the flexibility of working from home

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Senior AI Engineer – Stockholm (Hybrid)
   

 A fast‑growing digital product company is looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how AI is used across the product and internal systems. The business has a strong customer base, a modern tech culture, and a track record of building simple, impactful digital experiences with a focus on quality, speed and user value.
   

 The engineering and product organisation is around 20 people, with a flat, collaborative culture and plenty of ownership. This role will be the first AI‑focused hire and will play a key part in exploring where AI can make a meaningful difference.

This includes automating parts of the customer journey, building internal tools, improving existing systems and shaping new ideas from concept to production.

 What makes you a great fit4+ years of professional software engineering experienceStrong computer science fundamentals and good judgment in system designHands‑on experience building AI or LLM‑driven features in a real productComfortable working with ambiguity and shaping early ideasAble to collaborate well with product, design and engineering teamsMotivated by solving real customer problems and shipping useful featuresCurious, pragmatic and eager to keep learning
   

 What’s offered30 days vacationITP1 pension4,000 SEK wellness allowanceMac and phone of your choiceLearning and development budgetHybrid work model (typically 2–3 days a week in the Stockholm office)A friendly, flat, fast-moving tech environment with plenty of ownership
   

 This is an opportunity to be the key AI-focused engineer in a modern, product-driven company and help shape how AI is integrated into a widely used consumer experience.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
   

  

 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
   

  

 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
   

  

**The role**
 At Helsing, our engineering culture is defined by technical impact, first-principles thinking, and high-agency execution. We are looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to serve as a primary technical anchor, driving architectural decisions and shipping code across our backend systems.
   

  

 Designed for a builder who thrives on complexity and wants to remain close to the metal, you will have the autonomy to own projects from zero to one prototyping through to deploying resilient software on physical hardware.
   

  

 Your impact is measured by your ability to design robust systems, write performance-optimised code, and act as a technical multiplier for our teams. You will architect solutions across highly resilient distributed systems built for network partitions, resource-constrained embedded hardware, secure networking protocols, and high-performance machine learning inference pipelines directly at the tactical edge.
   

  

**The day-to-day**
* Lead the review of complex code contributions, design proposals, and technical RFCs from colleagues. At Helsing we strongly believe that unblocking others and mentoring is the highest-leverage work you can do.
* Architect, propose, and implement major new features, capabilities, algorithms, infrastructure, or full products across our stack. We expect our engineers to look beyond their immediate team, identify systemic opportunities, and champion the solutions.
* Act as a key translator between engineering and the broader business. You will regularly interface with product managers, programme leads, and customers to translate deep technical designs and constraints into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders who depend on our technologies.
* Actively mentor engineers, find mentees, and help drive and scale our technical interviewing pipeline. You will be a key driver in fostering, growing, and scaling the engineering organisation.
* Share your extensive experience and technical know-how with other Helsingers. We host tech talks, run "let’s learn together" groups, and host topical office hours (e.g., on Rust) to help the entire engineering team get better with time.
* Maintain and evolve our existing software stack, partnering with internal and external stakeholders to diagnose complex system issues, optimise operational reliability and performance, and systematically address technical debt. Our stack is a mix of Rust and Python, with Python mainly living in the ML-heavy sections.
* Design and develop robust test architectures and benchmarks, both at the micro and macro level. We operate in a domain where robustness is of the utmost importance, and building highly reliable, performance-tested systems is key to achieving that.
* Present and celebrate your work at our weekly demo sessions. We host demo sessions that allow early feedback, celebration of progress, and a better shared understanding of everything that goes on at Helsing.


**You should apply if you**
* Have a proven track record of writing highly legible, maintainable, and performance-optimised systems code.
* Are a systems-level thinker capable of designing for the long term. You can ensure that a complex collection of independent, heterogeneous systems (including those outside your direct control) successfully integrate and function reliably end-to-end.
* Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing, with the ability to articulate complex architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Thrive in a collaborative, low-ego environment, with extensive experience running pair programming and peer code reviews.
* Are highly comfortable working asynchronously (writing robust PRs, leading design RFCs, and having discussions by email).
* Have seasoned, senior-to-staff level backend development experience, with expert-level mastery in a systems language like Rust, Java, Go, or C++.
* Are a natural multiplier, striving to constantly improve yourself, your peers, and the engineering culture around you.
* Feel like ethical considerations are an inherent part of software engineering.


*Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.*
**Nice to have**
* Production-grade Rust and Python specifically.
* Container-based and cloud-native application architectures (e.g., Docker, Azure, AWS).
* Metrics and observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).

* Cryptographic protocols (e.g., Signal, WireGuard).
* Hardware interfaces (e.g., Arduino).
* Robotics (e.g., control systems).
* Production ML systems and model deployment.


**Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields**
* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.


**What We Offer**
* A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking
* Competitive compensation and VSOP options

title: Senior AI Engineer to Handelsbanken
description:
Join Handelsbanken’s AI & Automation department and help shape how we apply Agentic, Generative and Predictive AI at scale across the bank.
   

  

**Your team**
 The Agentic AI & Automation Team is part of Handelsbanken’s AI & Automation department, which leads the bank’s AI transformation. Our team is focused on developing next-generation solutions that combine AI agents, automation and advanced analytics to transform how the bank operates and serves customers.
   

  

 We work across the organization to develop high-impact solutions in areas such as customer experience, operations and decision-making. You will be joining a team with strong momentum, high ambitions and the opportunity to shape a new capability area from the ground up.
   

  

**Your role**
 As an AI Engineer, you will be at the forefront of combining automation and AI to build intelligent, autonomous solutions that solve real business problems. You will work end-to-end — from understanding business needs to designing, building, deploying and improving solutions in production.
   

  

 Your work will include:
   

  

* Building AI and automation solutions with focus on Agentic AI and Generative AI
* Driving end-to-end solution development together with a Product Manager:
* 
+ Understanding business problems and requirements
+ Designing and developing solutions
+ Testing and validating outcomes
+ Deploying and productionizing solutions
+ Monitoring, maintaining and continuously improving solutions

* Collaborating closely with business stakeholders, engineers and other AI specialists
* Mentoring junior engineers or leading technical initiatives


 This is a highly hands-on, impact-driven role where you will take ownership and help define how Agentic AI and automation are applied across the bank.
   

  

**Your profile**
 We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced engineer with strong technical capabilities, curiosity and a drive to build scalable, production-grade solutions that create measurable business value. You thrive in an evolving, fast-moving environment where you take full ownership of complex problems — from idea to production — and help shape both technical direction and ways of working. You are a strong individual contributor who also mentors others and collaborates closely with both technical and business stakeholders. Since we collaborate across the organisation, strong communication skills in Swedish are important.
   

  

 You combine deep technical expertise with a strong understanding of how to translate business needs into robust, scalable solutions.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Master’s degree, PhD or equivalent in a technical or quantitative field
* Proven track record of building and deploying production-ready AI, automation or software solutions
* Advanced programming skills (preferably Python) and strong software engineering practices
* Strong understanding of applied statistics, mathematics and/or machine learning
* Ability to design scalable architectures and make sound technical decisions
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Ability to independently drive initiatives from idea to production
* Strong business understanding and ability to identify high-impact opportunities
* A proactive mindset and drive to continuously improve both solutions and ways of working


 Experience in one or more of the following is highly valued
   

  

* Hands-on experience with Generative AI, Predictive AI and/or Agentic AI in production
* Automation development at scale (e.g. UiPath or similar tools)
* Designing and implementing end-to-end AI/automation solutions
* Working across the full lifecycle from ideation to deployment and maintenance
* Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading technical initiatives

title: Senior Agentic NetSuite Developer
description:
**Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking, from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We’re an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Creating and collaborating to transform the sound of streaming, content, and culture. Come join us, and let the world** 
***feel***
**your work.**
 As a Senior Agentic NetSuite Developer, you will play a crucial role in the Financial Systems team that owns the systems running Epidemic Sound's financial backbone. Your role will be to set the technical direction for our NetSuite platform, lead the architecture that connects it to the rest of our business, and shape how AI and agentic tooling change the way ERP work gets done here.
   

  

 This focus on AI and agentic tools is central to our broader strategy of accelerating the company’s transformation toward smarter, more scalable ways-of-working by embedding agentic AI at the core of business operations and system development.
   

  

 You'll Work At The Intersection Of Tech And Finance, Where The Systems You Build Directly Affect How Reliably We Close The Books, Run Controls, And Scale Operations As The Company Grows. Specifically
   

  

* This role drives the modernisation of our ERP platform and integration landscape, ensuring Finance, Tech, and operational teams can move quickly on a foundation that's accurate, compliant, and built for scale.
* Your work will reduce manual effort across financial processes, raise the bar on data integrity and audit-readiness, and define how we adopt AI capabilities inside NetSuite and beyond.
* You'll join a small, senior team of ERP, CRM and Data engineers focused on internal business systems. It's a team that values craft, ownership, and clear technical judgement over process for its own sake, and which uses modern data tooling to optimise performance and scalability.
* You'll collaborate closely with engineers across the Tech organisation, the Finance team (Accounting, FP&A, Controlling), Procurement, and external implementation partners — communicating directly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders without translation layers in between.
* In collaboration with the team you will assess the technical problems, design best-practice solutions, and determine the appropriate implementation approach—whether through NetSuite development, configuration, or external systems (e.g., the pre-system data platform).


**Your Key Responsibilities Include**
* Owning and evolving our NetSuite platform and AI strategy — directing AI-assisted development to accelerate delivery and reduce manual configuration, while maintaining a clear point of view on which of NetSuite's emerging AI capabilities and third-party agentic tools we should adopt and when.
* Designing agentic workflows where AI handles repetitive financial processes — reconciliations, approvals, data routing — end-to-end, with appropriate human oversight built in.
* Leading integration architecture across NetSuite and adjacent systems, acting as technical lead and quality reviewer for AI-generated scripts, integrations, and automations.
* Driving compliance and continuous improvement, using AI-assisted analysis to proactively surface data integrity issues, audit risks, and optimisation opportunities.
* Providing technical mentorship, supporting training materials to broaden ERP know-how across the organisation, and helping grow the Tech team through interviewing, onboarding, and contributing to best practices.


**Requirements**
* At least 6 years of hands-on ERP experience with strong NetSuite expertise across configuration, SuiteScript, workflows, and integrations — ideally in a publicly listed or compliance-heavy environment.
* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Business Information Technology, or a related field.
* An agentic development mindset. A genuine understanding of how AI coding assistants and agentic tools change the ERP specialist's role, with real experience reviewing and validating AI-generated outputs. You understand where agents add leverage and where human judgment is non-negotiable.
* Deep knowledge of financial processes and ERP architecture, with the analytical ability to design solutions that hold up at scale and across complex, multi-variable scenarios.
* Strong project leadership and stakeholder communication — a track record of driving initiatives from discovery to measurable business impact, and translating between business intent and technical execution without intermediaries.


**It would also be music to our ears if you have**
* NetSuite/ERP systems and their integration with Salesforce
* Invoice to pay software (e.g Medius), Spend management software (e.g Expensify), Consolidation software (e.g Aaro), Planning and Budgeting software (e.g NSPB)
* Experience with SuiteCommerce Advanced or NetSuite’s Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) module.
* NetSuite MCP Standard Tools SuiteApp
* Familiarity with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD) for NetSuite development.
* Agile methodology and how to work in agile teams.


**Equal opportunity employer**
 We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.
   

  

**Application**
 Ready to make the world
 *feel* 
 your work? Please apply, in English.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Automotive (Customer Facing)
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a highly motivated Machine Learning Engineer to develop and deploy AI solutions for automotive applications running on Infineon Automotive microcontrollers.
 



 In this role, you will collaborate with automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, systems engineers, and embedded software teams to bring machine learning capabilities to safety-critical automotive systems. You will be responsible for designing, optimizing, and deploying machine learning models for resource-constrained environments, enabling intelligent sensing, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, driver monitoring, vehicle diagnostics, and other advanced automotive use cases.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning expertise with a solid understanding of embedded systems, automotive software development, and real-time constraints.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, train, validate, and optimize machine learning models for automotive applications on Infineon microcontrollers such as AURIX™, Traveo™ and PSOC™.
* Work with sensor, system, and application experts to identify suitable AI approaches for customer problems.
* Collect, analyze, and preprocess automotive sensor and system data, define data collection and labeling strategies, and develop validation methodologies that ensure robust machine learning model performance under real-world operating conditions.
* Support customers and internal teams in identifying and evaluating AI use cases and develop proof-of-concepts, demonstrations, and customer reference implementations demonstrating the value of Edge AI in automotive systems
* Participate in customer workshops, technical presentations, and solution reviews.



  
 



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor or Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong understanding of supervised learning, unsupervised learning, time-series analysis, signal processing, and deep learning fundamentals.
* Experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, ONNX, or equivalent frameworks.
* Experience deploying machine learning models on resource-constrained devices incl. knowledge of TinyML, model quantization, model compression, feature engineering, and real-time inference optimization.
* Strong programming skills in C, C++, and Python
* Familiarity with RTOS concepts, performance profiling, and automotive-grade microcontrollers.
* Proactive self-starter who takes ownership, contributes to strategic discussions, adapts to evolving priorities, and helps shape the future of our products.
* Collaborative and independent engineer who maintains high programming standards while supporting colleagues and ensuring customer success.



  
 



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Understanding of automotive electronics and software architectures.
* Familiarity with AUTOSAR, ISO 26262, and automotive development processes.
* Experience integrating software in safety-critical or real-time systems is desirable.
* Experience with automotive radar, inertial sensing, acoustic sensing, motor control, battery management systems, or industrial sensing applications.



  
 



**What we offer:** 



* The opportunity to further develop our development platform, responsible for bringing deep learning to the edge
* Being a part of an excellent international team with highly motivated individuals striving for a common goal
* A chance to be a part of solving real-world problems using ML
* Competitive salary, wellness allowance, possibility to attend online-courses
* A humble and an open-minded company culture
* Opportunities to grow with the company and advance your career
* Short decision paths, we love getting things done
* An office in central Stockholm and the flexibility of working from home

description:

In this crossfunctional team we innovate in areas that push the boundaries for what open-world sandbox gaming means as well as enhance our players' online experience within our live-service games.
   

  

**The Position**
 In this role, you will contribute to developing and optimising our backend platform, Apex Connect, and its infrastructure in the cloud.
