title: Data Analyst - Digital Tech
description:
**Job Description**  

We are seeking **2x Data Analyst** to lead and coordinate analytical initiatives across one of our Areas within Commercial. This role involves driving the full analytical lifecycle—from hypothesis development through data analysis to actionable insights and strategic recommendations while ensuring data quality, accessibility, and reliability throughout the process.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to shape product strategies and prioritize initiatives through data-informed insights.
* Drive customer-centricity by analyzing behavioral, commercial, and product performance data to enhance the digital experience.
* Define and monitor key KPIs and implement event tracking to evaluate product performance and ensure alignment with intended outcomes.
* Lead the development of business cases by integrating commercial, digital, and user behavior insights.
* Promote a data-driven culture by enhancing data visibility, educating stakeholders, and translating complex data into actionable narratives.
* Write efficient SQL and code to query, aggregate, and transform large datasets with high data quality.
* Use tools such as BigQuery, Looker, and Power BI to explore, visualize, and communicate insights.
* Actively contribute to the analytics community within the Commercial domain and across the H&M Group.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**  

You’ll join a global, cross-functional team committed to delivering exceptional digital experiences through close collaboration, user-centric design, and continuous iteration. The team brings together diverse expertise across Product Design, Analytics, and Engineering, and partners closely with other product teams within the global digital experience organization, as well as key business stakeholders.

**WHO YOU ARE**  

*We are looking for people with…*


* Experience from product or business analysis, customer or commercial analytics, management consulting, or data engineering
* Strong experience with SQL, proficiency in Python is a plus
* Previous experience with cloud analytics environments such as Databricks or GCP
* Previous experience within ecommerce, retail, fashion or tech product driven companies
* Academic degree within Business Administration, Economics, Engineering (or similar)
* Experience in working with data visualization tools e.g. Power BI, Tableau, Google Data Studio, Looker Studio, etc
* Demonstrated ability to synthesize large amounts of data into clear insights
* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders across different competences (Commercial Leads, eCommerce Managers, Product Managers, Developers, Designers, Data Engineers, etc.)
* Be comfortable with working within a large matrix organization

*And people who have…*


* Experience working in agile, iterative product development environments
* A proactive, ownership-driven attitude with the ability to manage ambiguity and adapt quickly to change
* Curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset—always looking for ways to enhance the product and the team’s ways of working

**Please note:** The role is based in **Stockholm** and we value close collaboration, with an expectation to work from office 4-days per week.


To be considered for this position, you must have an existing right to work in Sweden, as we are unfortunately unable to offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.

 **Additional Information** **WHO WE ARE**  

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.


**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**  

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.


* We offer all our employee’s attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a 25% staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.
* 30 days holiday
* We offer a collective agreement which includes pension and life insurance
* H&M Incentive Program
* Wellness benefit 4000kr/year
* Benifex Benefits Portal
* Community with activities

**JOIN US**. Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.


* *We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

title: VMware Engineer
description:
Vill du arbeta med VMware i en miljö där prestanda, säkerhet och tillgänglighet verkligen spelar roll?
  
Vi söker nu VMware Engineers till en av Sveriges mest samhällsviktiga aktörer. Här får du vara med i en omfattande teknisk transformation där en helt ny infrastrukturbaserad betalningsplattform byggs och etableras från grunden.
  
Det här är inte en roll där du kliver in för att enbart hålla en befintlig VMware-miljö rullande. Du kommer in mitt i uppbyggnaden och får möjlighet att påverka arkitektur, tekniska vägval, automation, säkerhet och hur plattformen ska fungera under många år framöver.
  
För rätt person är det en möjlighet att arbeta med modern VMware-teknik i en miljö som få organisationer i Sverige kan erbjuda.
  
  

**Om rollen:**  

Som VMware Engineer blir du en central del av teamet som bygger, etablerar och vidareutvecklar den nya plattformen.
  
VMware Cloud Foundation är en viktig del av miljön och du kommer att arbeta med hela kedjan från design och implementation till automation, integration, säkerhet och stabil drift.
  
Du kommer in i en fas där mycket händer samtidigt. Ny infrastruktur byggs, befintliga miljöer moderniseras och migreras samtidigt som nya tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt etableras.
  
Det innebär att du får arbeta både hands-on på djupet och med den långsiktiga utvecklingen av plattformen.
  
Här finns komplexiteten, resurserna och de tekniska utmaningarna för dig som vill mer än traditionell VMware-förvaltning.
  
  

**Det här kommer du att arbeta med:**  

Design, implementation och vidareutveckling av VMware-baserad infrastruktur
  
  

VMware Cloud Foundation och tekniker kopplade till plattformen
  
  

Uppbyggnad och etablering av en helt ny infrastrukturplattform
  
  

Automation och orkestrering av infrastruktur och återkommande processer
  
  

Integrationer mellan plattformar, system och tjänster
  
  

Tillgänglighet, redundans, kapacitet och prestanda i kritiska miljöer
  
  

Härdning, säkerhetsarbete och robust drift
  
  

Migrering och modernisering av befintliga miljöer
  
  

Felsökning och problemlösning i stora och komplexa infrastrukturer
  
  

Nära samarbete med andra specialister inom infrastruktur, nätverk, säkerhet, Kubernetes och arkitektur
  
  

Vem söker vi?
  
Vi söker dig som kan VMware på djupet och som vill använda den kompetensen till att bygga något nytt.
  
Du har arbetat med större virtualiserade miljöer och känner dig hemma i komplex infrastruktur där stabilitet och säkerhet är avgörande. Samtidigt är du nyfiken på hur saker kan göras bättre, smartare och mer automatiserat.
  
Du behöver inte kunna allt från dag ett. Det viktigaste är att du har en stark grund inom VMware och infrastruktur och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med andra erfarna tekniker.
  
  

**Vi tror att du har:**  

Flera års erfarenhet av VMware och virtualiserad infrastruktur

The role will involve driving highly technical projects close to core infrastructure, hardware, networks and security capabilities. One of your first assignments will be to lead a strategically important initiative within infrastructure and cyber security, helping to ensure that SEB’s security posture remains robust and future-ready as technology and threat landscapes continue to evolve.

  


  

**To thrive in this role, we believe you have:**



* Proven experience leading complex technical or IT infrastructure related initiatives from planning to delivery, with responsibility for scope, progress, dependencies, risks and outcomes.
* A good understanding of infrastructure and cyber security environments, such as networks, data centres, servers, cloud platforms, identity and access management, security monitoring or IT operations, and how these areas impact project planning, prioritisation and delivery.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
### **About agentmama**


We build AI agents that audit and optimize e-commerce advertising. Our platform syncs live data from Google Ads, Meta, Merchant Center, and Google Analytics, runs it through a rule engine, LLM-powered audit agents, and our own prediction models, and turns the findings into concrete actions marketers can apply with one click.


We're a small team shipping fast on a modern, strictly-typed stack. You'd be one of a handful of engineers reporting directly to the CTO, which means real ownership: features you design end-to-end, from the Prisma schema to the React component, ship to customers within days.

### **What you'll do**

* Design and build features across our TypeScript monorepo — tRPC procedures and NestJS services on the backend, React on the frontend.
* Extend our integration workers that sync campaign, product, and analytics data from the Google and Meta APIs via Cloud Pub/Sub pipelines.
* Work on the AI audit agent: prompt design, rule evaluation, and the plumbing that turns LLM output into reliable, deduplicated actions — across multiple model providers, not just one.
* Help productionize our in-house prediction models: wiring their output into the rule engine and keeping training data and evaluation pipelines healthy.
* Evolve the data model in PostgreSQL/Prisma and keep migrations, multi-tenancy, and role-based access clean as the product grows.
* Own quality: write Jest tests alongside your code, review PRs, and help keep our CI/CD pipeline to Cloud Run fast and boring.

### **Our stack**

##### **Backend**


TypeScript · Node.js  

NestJS + Fastify  

tRPC · Zod  

Prisma · PostgreSQL

##### **Frontend**


React · Vite  

End-to-end types via tRPC

##### **Infrastructure**


Google Cloud Run · Pub/Sub  

Docker · GitHub Actions  

pnpm workspaces · Turborepo

##### **AI & integrations**


Multiple LLM providers  

In-house prediction models  

Google Ads · Meta  

Merchant Center · GA4

### **What we're looking for**

* 5+ years building production web applications, with strong TypeScript on both server and client.
* Solid relational database instincts — schema design, migrations, and query performance in PostgreSQL (Prisma experience is a plus).
* Experience with event-driven or queue-based architectures (Pub/Sub, SQS, Kafka, or similar) and the failure modes that come with them.
* A habit of testing: you write tests because they let you move faster, not because someone told you to.
* Pragmatic product sense — you ask why before how, and you'd rather ship a focused feature than a perfect abstraction.

### **Nice to have**

* Hands-on work with LLM APIs in production — prompting, evals, structured output, cost control, and switching between providers.
* Applied ML experience: training, evaluating, or serving prediction models alongside product code.
* Familiarity with the Google Ads, Meta, or Merchant Center APIs, or ad-tech / e-commerce domain experience.
* NestJS, tRPC, or GCP (Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Workload Identity) in a previous role.

### **How we work**


Small team, short feedback loops, no ceremony for ceremony's sake. Strict TypeScript, code review on everything, CI that deploys to Cloud Run on merge. We optimize for shipping value to customers weekly and keeping the codebase a place people enjoy working in.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
**Safety Bolt**
---------------


We're Safety Bolt and given our recent €2.6M fundraise and €13M LOI, we're seeking highly driven, top 1% talent to join our team and scale our monitoring solution to a multi billion euro infrastructure market.


If you're simply looking for a job, this is not for you. We seek highly motivated people who proactively and obsessively strive to solve novel problems all the way to product launch and beyond, fundamentally changing the way we build, maintain and monitor physical structures.

**What we do**


We build retrofittable sensors that measure the clamping force inside a bolted joint. Using magnetostrictive sensing, each sensor reads the stress in a standard steel bolt without touching it and without modifying the joint, then reports over LoRaWAN to a cloud platform where trend analysis reveals developing risk long before an inspection would. It clips on in under a minute and delivers structural integrity data for up to twenty years.


Bolted joints hold up critical infrastructure everywhere: wind energy, bridges and civil infrastructure, rail, tunnels and mining, and heavy process industry. A single wind turbine alone holds over a thousand bolts whose tension is checked by hand, if at all, and loss of preload is one of the main drivers of structural failure. The same sensor addresses all of them.

**Why now**


With ex-McKinsey leadership, we have developed and patented industry-leading technology over the last 7 years and recently reached a technical breakthrough, enabling an oversubscribed seed round with top-tier investors (to be announced), selection as one of Sweden's top 33 startups, a place in NATO's DIANA program chosen out of 3400 startups, and a Letter of Intent to purchase 47 000 sensors.

**Vision:** Become the leading structural integrity data provider globally

**Target:** Volume production and distribution of retrofitted sensors, providing 20 years of structural integrity data

**Culture:** Truth seeking, high agency, pragmatic, entrepreneurial and hypothesis driven

**Seeking:** Exceptional drive, intelligence and integrity. Lead rather than follow.


\_\_\_

### **The Role**


You will be Safety Bolt's internal expert on bolted joint mechanics, material behavior, and structural integrity, and much more besides. In a company of this size, your role will be broad by design: you will contribute to sensor fastening concept development, own the mechanical design of test equipment, and act as a technical sounding board across the team. The foundation of the role is deep knowledge of how bolted connections work, how they fail, and what governs their behavior over time. On top of that, you will need to be comfortable rolling up your sleeves and doing hands-on mechanical work, CAD, and creative problem-solving, often in areas that cross into electronics and measurement.

### **What you will do**

* Be the internal expert on bolted joint mechanics: preload, friction, relaxation, and failure modes
* Lead or contribute to concept generation and evaluation for how the Safety Bolt sensor fastens to bolts, assessing concepts for installation simplicity, manufacturability, and long-term retention security
* Own the mechanical design of in-house test rigs and custom test equipment built with or for external partners
* Contribute to material selection, tolerance analysis, and structural decisions in the product design
* Act as a cross-disciplinary partner to EE and FW: the person who grounds system-level discussions in mechanical and materials reality
* Carry out CAD work in the early phase; over time, hand off CAD execution while maintaining design ownership

### **Must have**

* Solid knowledge of bolted joint mechanics: preload theory, friction coefficients, relaxation, and failure modes
* Materials engineering foundation: understanding of steel alloys under stress, fatigue loading, surface treatment, and corrosion
* Comfortable working across a broad and shifting scope, from detailed design work to technical discussions with external test institutes and partners
* Hands-on and experimental mindset: willing to build, test, adjust, and iterate on physical hardware
* CAD proficiency for design of mechanical components and fixtures (SolidWorks, CATIA, Creo, or equivalent)
* High ownership and independent drive: you define your own work agenda and take problems to conclusion

### **Nice to have**

* Experience designing mechanical test fixtures or custom structural test setups
* Background in industries where bolted joint integrity is safety-critical: wind energy, heavy infrastructure, mining, marine, or process industry
* Experience working with external test institutes or structural certification bodies
* Familiarity with fatigue analysis or FEM for structural components
* Interest in or exposure to sensor technology and measurement systems
* Experience in a startup or small-company environment with a broad and evolving scope

**Education**
-------------


MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Structural Engineering, or equivalent. A BSc with substantial, documented experience in bolted joint mechanics or structural integrity is considered.

### **Experience level**


5+ years in mechanical engineering with clear, documented exposure to bolted joint systems, fastening technology, or structural integrity in a load-bearing context. We are not looking for a generalist who has encountered bolts; we are looking for someone for whom this is a professional specialty.

title: Sensor Systems & Validation Engineer
description:
**Safety Bolt**
---------------


We're Safety Bolt and given our recent €2.6M fundraise and €13M LOI, we're seeking highly driven, top 1% talent to join our team and scale our monitoring solution to a multi billion euro infrastructure market.

**What we do**


We build retrofittable sensors that measure the clamping force inside a bolted joint. Using magnetostrictive sensing, each sensor reads the stress in a standard steel bolt without touching it and without modifying the joint, then reports over LoRaWAN to a cloud platform where trend analysis reveals developing risk long before an inspection would. It clips on in under a minute and delivers structural integrity data for up to twenty years.


Bolted joints hold up critical infrastructure everywhere: wind energy, bridges and civil infrastructure, rail, tunnels and mining, and heavy process industry. A single wind turbine alone holds over a thousand bolts whose tension is checked by hand, if at all, and loss of preload is one of the main drivers of structural failure. The same sensor addresses all of them.

**Why now**


With ex-McKinsey leadership, we have developed and patented industry-leading technology over the last 7 years and recently reached a technical breakthrough, enabling an oversubscribed seed round with top-tier investors (to be announced), selection as one of Sweden's top 33 startups, a place in NATO's DIANA program chosen out of 3400 startups, and a Letter of Intent to purchase 47 000 sensors.

**Vision:** Become the leading structural integrity data provider globally

**Target:** Volume production and distribution of retrofitted sensors, providing 20 years of structural integrity data

**Culture:** Truth seeking, high agency, pragmatic, entrepreneurial and hypothesis driven

**Seeking:** Exceptional drive, intelligence and integrity. Lead rather than follow.


\_\_\_

### **The Role**


This is not a conventional test engineering role. You will define and execute Safety Bolt's entire sensor characterization and validation program: designing the experiments, building the methodology, and finding the answers ourselves, since many of them do not yet exist. Your core task is to determine what the sensor can and cannot predict, under what conditions, and to what statistical confidence. You will work creatively across analog electronics, signal processing, and experimental design, and collaborate tightly with the firmware and mechanical engineers to translate findings into system specifications. Analog electronics competence is your foundation; curiosity and experimental rigor are what will make you excellent in this role.

### **What you will do**

* Design and execute a systematic test and validation program for the Safety Bolt sensor, from individual component characterization to full system behavior under real-world installation conditions
* Define the sensor operating envelope: boundary conditions, measurement uncertainty, and statistical confidence requirements
* Develop test fixtures, measurement protocols, and custom test setups for ESR and inductance characterization
* Work with unknown-variable scenarios: what can we predict with a known bolt type but unknown environmental context? Design the experiments that answer this
* Define production test procedures and give input to calibration routines, so that quality and consistency can be ensured at scale
* Collaborate with FW and ME to translate test results into requirements and guidelines
* Gradually take increasing ownership of the analog front-end design as the role and team mature

### **Must have**

* Solid foundation in analog electronics and measurement systems
* Ability to design, execute, and evaluate systematic test programs: from experiment design through statistical analysis
* Hands-on with measurement instrumentation: signal generators, impedance analyzers, oscilloscopes, lock-in amplifiers, or similar
* Comfort with open-ended experimental work where the methodology itself needs to be invented
* Cross-disciplinary thinking: prepared to work across electronics, signal processing, and algorithms as the problem requires
* High ownership: you define the test agenda, not just execute someone else's plan

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with analog front-end design, resonance circuits, or impedance spectroscopy
* Background in sensor characterization, measurement physics, or instrumentation engineering
* Experience with statistical experimental design (DOE) or measurement uncertainty analysis
* Knowledge of signal processing: DFT, FFT, frequency-domain analysis
* Experience developing custom test fixtures or measurement setups
* Background in industrial sensing, precision electronics, or research instrumentation

**Education**
-------------


MSc in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Measurement Technology, or equivalent. A BSc with strong analog and instrumentation background will be considered. A research background (PhD or industry research) is equally relevant; the role values scientific rigor over formal title.

### **Experience level**


3-6 years in a role involving measurement systems, sensor characterization, analog electronics, or experimental engineering. A conventional test engineer background is not required; we are equally interested in candidates from instrumentation, applied research, or precision measurement.

title: Agentic Managed Services Lead
description:
AI Agents are moving from pilot to production, and someone needs to make sure they continue to deliver value. As our Agentic Managed Services Lead, you will build the services that help customers support, maintain, optimise and govern their AI Agents over time.


This is a rare opportunity to shape a new service from the ground up. Part entrepreneur, part service architect and part hands-on delivery lead, you will turn an emerging idea into a scalable and commercially viable Fellowmind service.

**About the role**
==================


As our Agentic Managed Services Lead, you will define and own the Managed Services layer of the Fellowmind Agent Lifecycle.


You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Lifecycle, as well as our Product and HiveAI Technology teams, to ensure that managed services are built into the offering from the start rather than added afterwards.


Your responsibility goes beyond designing the service. You will help sell it, personally lead the first customer engagements and develop the playbooks, tools and ways of working needed to make the service operational. Once the model has been proven, you will enable our regional Managed Services teams to take ownership and scale it across Fellowmind.

#### **What you will do:**

* Design the service. Define services for the support, maintenance, optimisation and governance of AI Agents as an extension of the Fellowmind Agent Lifecycle.
* Prove it in practice. Launch and personally run the first Agentic Managed Services engagements, including onboarding, tooling, playbooks and delivery.
* Create a repeatable model. Develop the procedures, governance models and ways of working required for other teams to deliver the service successfully.
* Drive adoption across Fellowmind. Build the processes, roles and internal commitment needed to embed the service in our Managed Services organisations across different countries.
* Make it commercially viable. Own pricing, packaging and service commitments, and work with Sales and Marketing to position Agentic Managed Services as a core part of Fellowmind’s AI and HiveAI proposition.
* Prepare the service to scale. Transfer knowledge and ownership to regional teams once the model has been tested and proven with customers.
#### **What success looks like**


During your first six to nine months, the ambition is to have:

* At least one fully operational Agentic Managed Service live with a reference customer in production.
* Repeatable playbooks, procedures and governance models that other teams can adopt and use.
* At least one Managed Services organisation in a Fellowmind country delivering the service independently.
* A proven model that is ready to scale across Fellowmind’s country organisations.
**Who are you?**
================


You combine strategic thinking with the ability and willingness to make things happen in practice. You are entrepreneurial, outcome-driven and equally comfortable discussing direction and commercial models as you are working through the operational details of a new service.


You know how to create structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. You can influence stakeholders across countries and disciplines, and you would rather test and prove that a service works than stop at writing the plan.

#### **We believe that you bring:**

* Operational experience within Managed Services and automation.
* A track record in Service Management, Customer Success and Business Transformation.
* Experience taking a new service from concept to commercial and operational reality.
* The ability to lead change in a multi-country and multi-stakeholder organisation.
* A strong commercial mindset and an understanding of how to build a recurring-revenue, service-based business.
* Exposure to AI, automation, Copilot or agent-based solutions.

You do not need to be the person building the AI Agents yourself. What matters is your ability to understand the service around them and bring together customer value, commercial thinking, governance and operational delivery.

**Why Fellowmind?**
===================


You will have the opportunity to build something new while working closely with colleagues across product, technology, sales, marketing and Managed Services. The role gives you room to shape both the service itself and how it will be delivered across Fellowmind.


Fellowmind combines deep industry knowledge and personal guidance with Microsoft cloud technology across ERP, cloud infrastructure, data analytics and AI, CRM, intranet and Modern Workplace. We are an international organisation with more than 2,000 colleagues in the Netherlands, Denmark, Finland, Poland and Sweden.


Our culture is built around putting people at the heart of what we do. We value collaboration, personal responsibility, development and the freedom to find a sustainable balance between work and life.

**What is HiveAI?**
===================


At Fellowmind we're building HiveAI: a platform for developing, deploying and operating AI solutions at scale. It gives our customers one secure, scalable foundation for enterprise AI, instead of a collection of pilots that never quite make it to production. Read more about HiveAI here!

**The practicalities**
======================


Start: As soon as possible, but of course we'll take your notice period into account.


Scope: Full-time.


Location: One of our Swedish offices.


Travel: This is an international role, and regular travel across Fellowmind's countries and customer environments is an expected and rewarding part of the job.


Language: Professional proficiency in both English and Swedish is required.


Process: Initial screening interview, in-depth interviews, assessments/case work and reference checks.

title: Kommunikatör
description:

Pastoratet är indelat i fyra arbetslag. Vi samarbetar nära kommunen, föreningslivet och lokala aktörer och vill fortsätta utveckla ett rikt musikliv med bredd och kvalitet – för alla åldrar och i många uttryck.

title: Logistics Specialist (AWS Data Center)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Job summary  

Be a part of operating the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure. Amazon Web Services is seeking a bright, motivated and hard working individual for the Data Center Logistics Specialist position. The ideal candidate possesses a strong work ethic, attention to detail, the ability to meet deadlines and a commitment to Operational Excellence.  

  

The Logistics Specialist reviews data center inventory, in-bound shipments and ongoing demand to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained in all locations to support build and repair activities. Working with the Logistics Manager, they create plans to optimize the flow of parts through their lifecycle; tracking inventory location, movement, age, and turns. They work closely with Data Center Operations Technicians and Data Center Engineers to fulfill parts quickly and accurately. They work with Procurement and Hardware Engineering to source new parts and interface directly with vendors to process RMAs and receive replacements. They are responsible for accurate data entry and resolving questions from peer organizations.  

  

The ideal Logistics Specialist will dive deep into data to understand everything about the data center asset lifecycle. They maintain up-to-date metrics dashboards and create reports for internal and external suppliers and management as required.  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, logistics specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Responsibilities are divided between manual and administration tasks, including:  

* Coordination of all inbound/outbound deliveries, liaise with vendors, couriers/carriers, transportation and inventory planning teams.
* Receiving/shipping parts logically and physically, ensuring our Inventory management system is up to date and accurate at all times.
* Working closely with internal customers to fulfill parts quickly and accurately.
* Responsible for accurate data entry and resolving questions from peer organizations.
* Executing stock re-balancing through transfers between locations locally and globally, to ensure stock utilization and availability maximization of parts on each location.
* Responsible for Inventory management, regular cycle counts, customer-oriented storage space optimization, cleanliness, organization and safety of all workspace.
* Ad hoc analysis and projects based on business needs.
* Reverse Logistics; interface directly with vendors to process warranty parts returns and receive replacements.

  

Logistics Specialists are expected to understand all aspects of the production, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain high levels of quality and be willing to travel to support other locations within and outside the country.  

  

* Please apply with an English version of your resume

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship & Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Manual handling experience as a logistics professional supporting inventory maintenance/cycle counts and inbound/outbound shipments processing
* Valid EU drivers license

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Relevant Degree in Logistics or Supply Chain
* Experience of working within a complex logistics set-up. Experience in Data Center is a plus
* Project Management experience
* Ability to identify issues, develop solutions and drive results
* Good knowledge of IT and network equipment

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: AI Engineer
description:

 **international team**

 We invest in

As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise.  **a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect** 
 , with psychological safety at its core
 **.**

 Our
 **hybrid working model** 
 combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we also offer
 **wellbeing benefits** 
 like insurance coverage and an annual wellness allowance. Depending on the role, our
 **competitive compensation model** 
 offers a fixed salary model or a hybrid model including base salary and a performance-based bonus.

title: IT-Säkerhetsspecialist
description:
Som IT-Säkerhetsspecialist med fokus på säkerhetsarkitektur blir du en nyckelperson i arbetet med att utveckla och stärka säkerheten i våra IT-miljöer och digitala tjänster. Du kommer att vara en viktig rådgivare till verksamhet, projekt, förvaltning och IT-leveranser för att säkerställa att säkerhet integreras från idé till implementation. Rollen kommer primärt att arbeta med att stärka teamet som arbetar med utvecklingsinitiativ och IT-Projekt.
   

  

 Du ingår i avdelningen IT-Säkerhet och arbetar tillsammans med arkitekter, säkerhetsspecialister, systemförvaltare, projektledare och andra experter för att skapa hållbara och säkra lösningar i en verksamhet som är avgörande för samhällets funktion.
   

  

**Dina Arbetsuppgifter Inkluderar Bland Annat Att:**
* Arbeta med att utveckla och vidareutveckla säkerhetsarkitektur, säkerhetsmönster, riktlinjer och metoder som säkerställer att säkerhet integreras i IT-lösningar från början.
* Stödja IT-projekt till en säker IT-leverans tillsammans med arkitekter, projektledare och verksamheten.
* Driva och utveckla säkerhetsarbetet tillsammans med verksamhetens IT-leverans och projektportfölj
* Bidra till att utveckla säkerhetsförmågan inom både IT- och OT-nära miljöer samt stödja arbetet med att hantera nya hot, risker och säkerhetskrav.
* Arbeta med att vidareutveckla interna krav genom t ex stärka rutiner, tydliggöra säkerhetskrav och löpande verksamhetsnära arbete
* Genomföra säkerhetsgranskningar, klassningar, risk och sårbarhetsanalyser samt rekommendera åtgärder.
* Proaktivt arbeta med leverantörshantering inom IT/Informationssäkerhet t ex uppföljning av krav, sätta processer för arbete med interna krav mm.


 Kvalifikationer
   

  

 Vi söker dig som är självgående och tar ansvar för att driva frågor framåt, särskilt inom IT-utvecklingsinitiativ. Du har en stark analytisk förmåga och kan omsätta komplexa frågeställningar till tydliga rekommendationer. Vidare arbetar du strukturerat och metodiskt även när förutsättningarna förändras, kommunicerar tryggt med såväl verksamhet som teknikorganisation och har ett pragmatiskt, lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt där säkerhetskrav balanseras mot verksamhetens behov.
   

  

**Vi Ser Gärna Att Du Har:**
* Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, datavetenskap eller systemvetenskap, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Erfarenhet inom IT-säkerhet, informationssäkerhet eller säkerhetsarkitektur och rådgivning i komplexa IT-miljöer.
* Erfarenhet av att genomföra säkerhetsgranskningar, riskanalyser och säkerhetsbedömningar.
* Erfarenhet av att omsätta säkerhetskrav till praktiska och verksamhetsanpassade lösningar.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med etablerade standarder och regelverk såsom ISO 27001, NIS2/Cybersäkerhetslagen, säkerhetsskyddslagstiftningen eller motsvarande.
* God förståelse för identitetshantering, åtkomststyrning och moderna säkerhetsprinciper.
* Svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


**Meriterande:**
* Säkerhetsarbete inom energi-, elnäts- eller annan samhällskritisk verksamhet eller erfarenhet ifrån arbete med IT/OT verksamhet

 om själva tjänsten kontakta rekryterande chef Filip Hammarlund, filip.hammarlund@vattenfall.com. För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontakta rekryterare Julia Norberg, julia.norberg@vattenfall.com.

 På Vattenfall värdesätter vi att vara aktiva, positiva, öppna och säkerhetsmedvetna. Vi söker medarbetare som delar vår vision och kan bidra till att stärka vår företagskultur.  Då säkerheten för Vattenfall och dess anställda är avgörande kommer vi innan varje anställning genomföra en ”pre-employment screening”. Dessa kontroller baseras på din roll som du kommer att fylla inom Vattenfall.

title: SOC Architect
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
   

  

**Your role**
 As a Cybersecurity SOC/SIEM Architect, you will be responsible for security monitoring, SOC operations, and SIEM-related activities across the environment. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in SOC and SIEM ecosystems, security monitoring technologies, and cyber threat detection and response. Most importantly, the candidate should have a solid understanding of the operational processes, procedures, governance frameworks, and best practices required to establish and maintain an effective security monitoring capability.
   

  

*In this role you will play a key role in:*
* Leading and enhancing Security Operations Centre (SOC) capabilities, ensuring effective security monitoring, threat detection, incident analysis, and response activities.
* Designing, implementing, and optimising SIEM platforms and security monitoring solutions, leveraging technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, Elastic, ArcSight, or equivalent tools.
* Defining and improving security monitoring operating models, governance frameworks, processes, procedures, and best practices required to deliver an effective SOC service
* Developing and maintaining detection use cases, correlation rules, alert workflows, monitoring KPIs, and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen threat detection capabilities
* Establishing and managing security monitoring runbooks, incident handling procedures, threat hunting activities, and operational processes to support security operations
* Driving log management and event monitoring capabilities, including log collection, normalisation, enrichment, correlation, and integration across enterprise security and IT environments


**Your profile**
* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, or related field
* Minimum 8-10 years of experience in SOC, Cyber Defense Center, Managed Security Services (MSSP), or Security Operations environments.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity monitoring frameworks, operating models, and best practices.
* Ability to bridge operational, architectural, and governance aspects of security monitoring and experience in documenting & formalizing security monitoring procedures & service workflows.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluency in English; Swedish language skills are advantageous


**What We Believe You Will Enjoy About Working Here**
* Working with cutting-edge telecom technologies, including 5G Core and cloud-native architectures
* Opportunities to contribute to large-scale transformation projects for leading telecom clients
* Being part of a collaborative, international, and highly skilled team
* Continuous learning opportunities and strong career development support


**Application**
 As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required.
   

  

**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology, and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

title: Customer Experience Customer Success Specialist
description:
**Meet the Team**
 The Customer Experience team is focused on helping customers achieve long-term success with their Splunk investment by ensuring the technical health, performance, and adoption of their environments. The team works closely with customers and internal cross-functional partners, including Technical Support, Professional Services, Sales, Product Management, and Engineering, to deliver a seamless and value-driven customer experience. This is a highly collaborative, customer-focused team made up of technical specialists who combine platform expertise with strong relationship management skills. What makes this team exciting is the opportunity to influence customer outcomes directly, solve complex technical challenges, and act as a trusted advisor throughout the customer lifecycle.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 Advise customers on the technical health of their Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud environments to support successful adoption and long-term value realization. Deliver onboarding guidance, enablement planning, and customer workshops to help customers build capability and optimize platform usage. Monitor customer environment health by reviewing cases, outages, critical issues, and ongoing projects, and conduct diagnostic health checks where needed. Partner with internal teams to manage escalations, recommend upgrades, support workload optimization, and ensure customers are informed about product changes, maintenance windows, and new feature availability in line with product roadmaps. Contribute to stronger customer relationships by translating customer needs into actionable insights for account teams and advocating internally to drive effective issue resolution. Participate in sales QBRs with customers (onsite and virtually) to review service levels, usage metrics and customer environment performance.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* 3+ years of experience in technical support, technical account management, professional services, systems administration, systems engineering, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing role
* Working knowledge of the Splunk Core Platform
* Experience with customer escalations, account management, and project coordination
* Experience with IT operations and technical infrastructure


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Splunk Architect Certification, or willingness to obtain it within 3–6 months
* Familiarity with Splunk-related products beyond the Core Platform
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
* Ability to work effectively with stakeholders across all levels, from individual contributors to senior leaders
* Strong customer service mindset with a proactive and solutions-oriented approach
* Ability to travel as required (20-30%)
* Committed to deliver customer success excellence in an ever-changing landscape


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Migration & Modernization Business Development Manager
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
 At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
   

  

 Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
   

  

 Job Summary:
   

  

 NetApp is helping organizations modernize their data infrastructure across hybrid and multi-cloud environments while maintaining control, security, governance, and flexibility. As organizations navigate cloud migrations, data center modernization, regulatory requirements, virtualization changes, and infrastructure refresh cycles, there is a significant opportunity for NetApp to engage earlier in transformation decisions.
   

  

 The Migration & Modernization Business Development Manager is responsible for creating demand, generating qualified pipeline, and accelerating growth across EMEA/LATAM. This is a highly strategic business development role focused on identifying market opportunities, engaging customers and partners, and driving measurable pipeline and bookings growth. Success will be measured by pipeline creation, opportunity progression, and business impact.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

**Drive Pipeline Growth**
* Own the Migration & Modernization pipeline generation strategy across EMEA/LATAM.
* Identify and prioritize target accounts based on modernization triggers such as infrastructure refreshes, end-of-life technologies, cloud migrations, virtualization changes, regulatory initiatives, and data center transformation projects.
* Work with Sales, Marketing, and Partners to execute campaigns, workshops, executive engagements, and assessments that generate qualified opportunities.
* Develop executive-level relationships and engage directly with customers to uncover and qualify opportunities.


 Accelerate Business Growth
   

  

* Expand opportunities within the existing customer base through modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.
* Drive net-new business through migration events, competitive displacement opportunities, and infrastructure transformation programs.
* Identify growth areas, improve conversion rates, and help scale repeatable demand-generation motions.


 Develop Go-to-Market Plays
   

  

* Create and refine migration and modernization value propositions focused on hybrid cloud, data center modernization, workload mobility, virtualization transformation, sovereignty, compliance, and consumption-based models.
* Build repeatable programs that provide account targeting, customer messaging, business value frameworks, competitive positioning, and pipeline generation activities.


 Enable the Field
   

  

* Equip Client Executives, Systems Engineers, and Partner teams with the tools, messaging, and frameworks needed to identify and qualify modernization opportunities.
* Support strategic opportunities through executive engagement, business case development, and competitive positioning.


 Partner & Ecosystem Engagement
   

  

* Build joint migration and modernization programs with hyperscalers, systems integrators, managed service providers, cloud providers, and other strategic partners.
* Drive partner-sourced pipeline through joint customer engagements and migration initiatives.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* 
+ Consistent creation of net-new, self-sourced Migration & Modernization pipeline.
+ Growth in bookings and opportunity conversion rates.
+ Increased partner-sourced opportunities and customer expansion initiatives.
+ Greater adoption of modernization plays across Sales and technical teams.
+ Increased engagement earlier in customer transformation decisions.


 Job Requirements:
   

  

**Required**
* 8+ years of experience in Business Development, Strategic Sales, Go-to-Market, Cloud Transformation, or Infrastructure Modernization.
* Proven track record of generating pipeline and influencing revenue growth within enterprise technology environments.
* Experience building target account strategies and identifying opportunities based on business or technology trigger events.
* Strong understanding of hybrid cloud, multi-cloud, data infrastructure, virtualization, cloud migration, and modernization strategies.
* Ability to develop and present business cases to senior business and technology leaders, including CIOs and CFOs.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Fluent English and willingness to travel across EMEA/LATAM as required.


**Preferred**
* Experience working with AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or large systems integrators.
* Understanding of regulatory and sovereignty requirements including DORA, NIS2, and data residency considerations.
* Experience supporting large-scale migration, virtualization, cloud, or data center transformation projects.
* Additional European language skills are advantageous.


 Why Join NetApp?
   

  

 You will play a pivotal role in helping customers modernize their infrastructure, transform how they manage data across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, and shape strategic technology decisions across EMEA and LATAM. This is an opportunity to build and scale a high-impact business motion with direct influence on growth, market expansion, and customer success.
   

  

 At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
 NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
   

  

**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
 At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
   

  

 NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
   

  

**Our culture**
 We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
   

  

 If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.
   

  

**Submitting an Application**
 To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.
   

  

**AI Disclosure**
 For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision-making.

title: Territory Account Manager
description:
**Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
 Nutanix is looking for a
 **Territory Account Manager** 
 to join our field sales team in Sweden. In this high-impact, national role, you will be tasked with driving net new business and growing existing relationships across
 **commercial enterprises throughout the country** 
 .
   

  

 You will be responsible for selling Nutanix’s hybrid multicloud products and solutions directly to commercial customers and prospects. Working closely with Systems Engineers and our extended account ecosystem, you will help Swedish businesses modernize their infrastructure and accelerate their digital transformation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At Nutanix, you will be joining our high-performing Swedish team—renowned for exceptional sales achievements and class-leading employee satisfaction (eNPS). We strongly value collaboration across functions and hierarchies, creating a supportive, dynamic, and rewarding culture.
   

  

 Because this is a national role, you will travel across Sweden to meet with prospective and existing commercial clients. This on-the-ground presence enables you to build deep, trusted relationships and deliver tangible impact to businesses nationwide.
   

  

**Your Role**
 As a
 **Territory Account Manager (Commercial)** 
 , you will serve as a key player in expanding our commercial footprint across Sweden.
   

  

* Drive Net New Business & Expansion: Proactively target, engage, and close new commercial accounts across the region while growing existing relationships.
* Technical Partnership: Work hand-in-hand with an experienced Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to design tailored solution proposals.
* Leverage the Partner Ecosystem: Forge and cultivate strong relationships with key Channel Partners, Resellers, Systems Integrators, and Alliance partners to execute joint go-to-market strategies.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Channel Sales, Marketing, Sales Operations, and Product Management to ensure optimal account coverage and customer success.
* Strategic Execution: Develop clear account plans for strategic commercial accounts and maintain accurate, timely sales forecasting within SFDC.
* Commercial Go-To-Market: Offer insight and feedback to guide localized marketing initiatives for the Swedish commercial market.


**What You Will Bring**
* 3+ years of successful outside software/IT solution sales experience.
* Proven Track Record: A history of consistently exceeding sales quotas in enterprise IT, cloud, or software environments.
* Commercial Market Expertise: A strong understanding of the Swedish commercial landscape, business culture, and partner ecosystem, backed by an established network of stakeholders.
* Business Acumen: Ability to articulate how Nutanix solves complex business challenges, acting as a trusted advisor to C-level executives and IT leaders.
* Strategic Territory Management: Expertise in target account planning, prospect identification, and consultative, solution-oriented selling.
* Collaborative & Entrepreneurial: High energy, self-motivated, and deeply committed to team success and transparent communication.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Swedish and English.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.


**Work Structure:** 
 This position is primarily remote/field-based with national travel across Sweden to engage with clients and partners. Occasional travel for team gatherings or global events may also be required.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

 Legora AB is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to play a lead role in shipping high-impact features and building scalable systems.  What You’ll Do

* Collaborate cross-functionally to translate business needs and product ideas into robust technical solutions
* Lead engineers through the full software development lifecycle—from ideation and scoping to development, release, and ongoing optimization

* Ensure code quality, documentation, and compliance standards are met as features move from prototype to release

* Deep understanding of system design, software architecture, and modern development practices
* Effective technical leader and mentor who prioritizes feature delivery without sacrificing quality
* Exceptional collaborator and communicator, comfortable working across disciplines and with stakeholders at all levels
* Advocate for continuous delivery, automation, and process efficiency


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Partner Engineer - Hardware Partnerships
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive and unmistakably Spotify.
   

  

 The In Home Hardware Partners team sits within the Experience Mission and connects Spotify engineering with some of our most strategic hardware partners. We help bring Spotify to connected devices by working closely with partners throughout integration, certification and launch. As the team continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Partner Engineer to help scale our technical partnerships and drive the next generation of Spotify experiences on connected devices.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Build trusted technical partnerships with strategic hardware manufacturers, including companies developing connected audio products.
* Lead technical integration projects from planning through launch, helping partners successfully adopt Spotify's Core Playback SDK.
* Collaborate with engineering, product and cross-functional teams to align priorities, remove blockers and deliver high-quality partner experiences.
* Drive technical discussions, architecture reviews, workshops and implementation planning with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Write clear technical proposals, RFCs and design documentation that help engineering teams make informed decisions.
* Monitor project health, proactively identify risks and coordinate solutions across multiple engineering teams.
* Investigate and resolve complex SDK, API and integration challenges, contributing code when appropriate.
* Help improve the tools, processes and developer experience that enable partners to build with Spotify more effectively.
* Contribute to the long-term evolution of Spotify's hardware platform by identifying opportunities to simplify integrations and scale partner success.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have a strong foundation in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* You have 5+ years of experience working in software engineering, partner engineering, developer relations, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.
* You are experienced with software development, SDKs, APIs, distributed systems or embedded technologies.
* You can comfortably read, understand, and contribute to production code while discussing technical architecture with engineers and technical partners.
* You have experience working across organizational boundaries and building strong relationships with both engineering teams and external partners.
* You know how to navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and keep complex technical initiatives moving forward.
* You communicate technical concepts clearly, adapting your approach for different audiences without losing technical depth.
* Experience with consumer electronics, connected devices, smart home products, audio platforms or hardware certification is valuable.
* Experience writing technical specifications, architecture proposals or RFCs is an advantage.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in Stockholm.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

title: Crypto quant engineer
description:
Crypto Quant / Strategy Engineer
 



  





 Remote | Full-time / Hybrid | BotHub Global AB
 



  





 About BotHub
 



  





 https://bothub.trade/
 



  





 BotHub is a non-custodial automated trading platform that allows users to connect their own exchange accounts and run systematic trading strategies directly on their accounts.
 



  





 We support major crypto exchanges and markets including Binance, Bybit, Kraken and Hyperliquid, with more than 2,400 registered users across 85+ countries.
 



  





 We're looking for someone with a track record of developing systematic crypto trading strategies that hold up beyond the backtest.
 



  





 The Role
 



  





 You'll research, develop, test and improve systematic crypto trading strategies for deployment on BotHub.
 



  





 We're particularly interested in futures and perpetual markets, including strategies capable of trading both long and short and using leverage within a defined risk framework.
 



  





 We are not looking for impressive backtest results alone.
 



  





 We want strategies that demonstrate robustness on data they were not developed or optimised against.
 



  





 That could include walk-forward testing, genuine out-of-sample testing, forward testing or verified live performance.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  





 - Research and develop systematic crypto trading strategies.
 



 - Build strategies for spot, futures and perpetual markets.
 



 - Develop systems capable of both long and short exposure.
 



 - Design appropriate position sizing, leverage and risk controls.
 



 - Validate strategies using walk-forward, out-of-sample and other robust testing methods.
 



 - Test whether strategies remain effective across different assets and market regimes.
 



 - Identify overfitting, look-ahead bias and other weaknesses that can produce misleading results.
 



 - Take successful research through to automated deployment.
 



 - Monitor deployed strategies and identify degradation or changing market behaviour.
 



 - Work alongside our technical team to improve our strategy research and testing infrastructure.
 



  





 Who We're Looking For
 



  





 The most important requirement is a demonstrable track record of developing systematic crypto trading strategies.
 



  





 You may have developed them professionally, independently, for your own capital or as part of another trading project.
 



  





 We care much more about what you've built and how you've validated it than your academic background or previous job titles.
 



  





 You should be able to demonstrate that you understand the full process:
 



  





 Hypothesis → Development → Validation → Unseen Data → Live/Forward Performance
 



  





 We're particularly interested in candidates who understand why a strategy works, where it is likely to fail and how to distinguish genuine robustness from overfitting.
 



  





 Coding & AI
 



  





 You need to be able to demonstrate experience building and working with quantitative trading code, but we do not require any particular programming language.
 



  





 BotHub is an AI-first company and we actively use AI throughout our development process.
 



  





 We have no issue with candidates using AI to write, debug or improve code.
 



  





 What matters is that you understand the code you're working with, can explain how it works and can verify that it is doing what you think it is doing.
 



  





 We care about your ability to solve problems and produce reliable systems — not whether you typed every line manually.
 



  





 What Counts as a Track Record?
 



  





 A backtest alone is not sufficient.
 



  





 We're looking for evidence that your strategies have been tested beyond the data they were developed on.
 



  





 Examples include:
 



  





 - Walk-forward or genuine out-of-sample results
 



 - Forward-testing results
 



 - Verified live trading history
 



 - Exchange records or read-only performance access
 



 - Public strategy performance
 



 - Professional references
 



 - Research, code or other evidence demonstrating your methodology
 



  





 You will not be expected to disclose proprietary alpha or hand over the logic of a successful strategy simply to apply.
 



  





 Application Process
 



  





 Because this is a remote role and we expect a high number of applications, we will review evidence before inviting candidates to interview.
 



  





 When applying, please answer the following:
 



  





 1. What systematic crypto trading strategies have you developed?
 



  





 Briefly describe the type of strategies, markets and timeframe involved.
 



  





 2. How did you validate them?
 



  





 Explain how you used unseen data, walk-forward testing, forward testing or live trading to determine whether the strategy was genuinely robust.
 



  





 3. What evidence can you provide?
 



  





 This could include verified performance, exchange history, research, code, public results or other supporting material.
 



  





 4. What experience do you have with futures, perpetuals, leverage and shorting?
 



  





 5. Tell us about a strategy that looked promising but failed further testing.
 



  





 What exposed the problem, and what did you learn from it?
 



  





 Shortlisted candidates will then be invited to a technical discussion focused on their previous work and approach to strategy development.
 



  





 For candidates progressing further, we may use a paid, scoped research assessment using market data.
 



  





 We do not use unpaid take-home projects.
 



  





 Why BotHub?
 



  





 You'll be working directly on one of the core parts of our product: the strategies our users automate.
 



  





 We're a small, technical and AI-first team. Good research can move quickly from an idea through validation and into production.
 



  





 We offer:
 



  





 - Fully remote working
 



 - Significant ownership over strategy research
 



 - Freedom to use modern AI development tools
 



 - Direct access to the engineering and founding teams
 



 - The opportunity to deploy research into real automated trading infrastructure
 



 - Competitive compensation
 



 - Equity opportunities for the right candidate
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Don't send us a generic cover letter.
 



  





 Show us what you've built.
 



  





 We're much more interested in seeing evidence of your work, how you tested it and how you think about trading systems than a polished CV.
 



  





 BotHub Global AB
 



  





 BotHub provides non-custodial trading automation technology. Users retain control of their assets and connect supported trading accounts through APIs. Past or simulated performance does not guarantee future results.
